recommendations.title: Recommended multilingual models
recommendations.hint: Whisper Base is the multilingual default. It detects the language and keeps the original speech, including Vietnamese. Download starts on first use. Start with Tiny if a larger model runs out of memory. English-only .en exports and distil-large-v3 do not support multilingual transcription.
recommendations.tiny: Low-memory option · smallest download and lowest memory use of these choices.
recommendations.base: Recommended default · balance of recognition capacity, speed, and memory use.
recommendations.small: More capacity for speech recognition · needs more memory and processing time.
recommendations.checkFailed: Could not check model files. Retry to enable this choice.
recommendations.unavailable: Required files or browser support are missing.

tab.expandHint: Original language · Click a segment to read the full text
tab.title: Tab recordings
tab.instructions: To start or stop, right-click a meeting or video page and choose Memorall → Start / stop tab transcription. Whisper Base is the multilingual default; you can change the model in Studio.
tab.audioScope: Captures audio played by that tab, including embedded players and meeting participants. Your microphone is only included if the tab plays it back. Protected audio and browser pages may not be capturable. Requires Chrome or Edge 116+.
tab.summaryModel: Summaries and notes use your selected chat model. If it is a cloud model, transcript text is sent to that provider. Audio transcription runs locally.
tab.save: Save transcript and notes to Files
tab.waiting: Waiting for the first audio window (about 20 seconds)…

status.failed: Stopped with an error — saved chunks kept

empty.title: Record or upload audio
empty.description: Get a transcript with timestamps. Click a timestamp to hear that moment.

record.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Open the site settings (the icon next to the address bar), allow the microphone, then press the button again.
record.unsupported: Recording is not available here. Upload a file instead.
